title.zh: 传递在其起约束之处的独立性
title.en: Independence of transmission where it binds

statement.en: Where transmission binds, dropping a giver's dependence keeps the other premises and finiteness and breaks it, so laws such drops keep never derive it; in finite, balanced, dissipative, embodied worlds where activity needs support, the reading of drawing and drawing as depending do, neither alone.
statement.zh: 传递在其起约束之处，去掉给予者的一条依存，其余前提与有限不变而传递失效，所以这样的去掉所保持的规律从不推出它；在有限、平衡、耗散、被体现且活动需要支持的世界中，取用的读法加上取用即依存推出它，二者各自都需要。

laws.en: Transmission at a descent, where x comes to stand across the step from t given to by g taking part, is inheritance (a dependence on c that x holds after the step held by g at t) with the need within δ (where both depend on c, x needs it at most δ more than g did); for the whole flow, transmission within δ is inheritance with the need within δ at every descent.
laws.zh: 在一次降生（x 跨第 t 步开始立，由参与的 g 给予）处，传递就是承继（x 步后持有的对 c 的依存为 g 在 t 时所持）加上 δ 之内的需要（二者都依存 c 处，x 对 c 的需要至多比 g 多 δ）；对整个流，δ 之内的传递就是每次降生处的承继与 δ 之内的需要。

laws.en: Dropping g's dependence on c at step t changes nothing else of the web: no level, activity, drawing or need, and no other dependence. It keeps support, activity needing support and every dependence at the next step, and, where x depends on c after the step, it breaks inheritance of c from g to x across it.
laws.zh: 去掉 g 在第 t 步对 c 的依存，网的其余都不变：水平、活动、取用、需要与其余每条依存。它保持支持、活动需要支持与下一步的每条依存；x 在这一步之后依存 c 时，它破坏 c 从 g 到 x 跨这一步的承继。

laws.en: In a world, dropping a dependence keeps the relata and the flow, every premise other than transmission that held (activity needing support, balance, only active giving, only active taking, dissipation, embodiment, a census) and finiteness; at a descent whose descendant depends on c after the step, dropping the giver's dependence on c at the giving step breaks transmission for every δ.
laws.zh: 在世界中，去掉一条依存，关系项与流不变，原成立的除传递外的每个前提（活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、耗散、体现、普查）与有限都保持；在后代步后依存 c 的降生处，去掉给予者在给予步对 c 的依存，对每个 δ 都破坏传递。

laws.en: So every world meeting the seven other premises in which transmission binds, some descendant depending on a condition after its step, has a neighbour, one dependence dropped, meeting all but transmission. The finite hatch meets all eight premises, and its neighbour with the parent's dependence on the food dropped is finite and meets all but transmission.
laws.zh: 所以每个满足其余七个前提、传递起约束（某后代步后依存某条件）的世界，都有一个去掉一条依存的邻居，满足除传递外的一切。有限孵化满足全部八个前提；它去掉亲代对食物依存的邻居是有限的，并满足除传递外的一切。

laws.en: No law kept by dropping a dependence derives transmission where it binds: a condition on worlds that every drop of a dependence keeps and that implies transmission holds only of worlds in which transmission does not bind.
laws.zh: 去掉依存时保持的规律都推不出起约束处的传递：每次去掉依存都保持、且蕴含传递的世界条件，只在传递不起约束的世界上成立。

laws.en: Two readings of the exchange: a relatum depends on c after the step it comes to stand only where each relatum giving to it drew on c at the giving step, or took from c across it. The second gives the first where only active relata take and only from what they draw on, and every drop of a dependence keeps both.
laws.zh: 交换的两种读法：关系项在它开始立的步之后依存 c，只当给予它的每个关系项在给予步取用 c，或跨该步从 c 取。在只有活跃者取用、且只从其所取用者取时，后者给出前者；每次去掉依存都保持二者。

laws.en: So the reading of drawing, with finiteness and the seven other premises, does not give transmission: not every finite world meeting them in which each relatum depends only on what its givers drew on transmits.
laws.zh: 所以取用的读法加上有限与其余七个前提不给出传递：满足它们、每个关系项只依存其给予者所取用者的有限世界，并非都传递。

laws.en: With drawing being depending (a relatum depends on c wherever it draws on c), the reading of drawing gives inheritance of c, and so does the reading of feeding where only active relata take and only from what they draw on.
laws.zh: 取用即依存（关系项凡取用 c 之处都依存 c）时，取用的读法给出 c 的承继；在只有活跃者取用、且只从其所取用者取时，喂养的读法亦然。

laws.en: In a balanced, dissipative world with a list holding every relatum once, the total of what stands never rises above its value at the first step; so in a finite, balanced, dissipative world one bound holds every level at every step.
laws.zh: 在平衡、耗散、有无重复地含每个关系项之列表的世界中，总立量从不超过第一步的值；所以在有限、平衡、耗散的世界中，有一个界在每一步约束每个水平。

laws.en: Where activity needs support and every relatum is embodied, the need half holds within any bound on the condition's level; with levels bounded, transmission is exactly inheritance of every condition, and so it is in every finite world meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support.
laws.zh: 活动需要支持且每个关系项都被体现时，需要的一半在该条件水平的任何界之内成立；水平有界时，传递恰是每个条件的承继；所以在每个满足平衡、耗散、体现与活动需要支持的有限世界中也是如此。

laws.en: So in a finite world meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support, the reading of drawing with drawing being depending gives transmission, as does the reading of feeding where only active relata take and only from what they draw on.
laws.zh: 所以在满足平衡、耗散、体现与活动需要支持的有限世界中，取用的读法加上取用即依存给出传递；在只有活跃者取用、且只从其所取用者取时，喂养的读法亦然。

laws.en: Not vacuously: in the finite hatch whose parent also depends on itself, a finite world meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support, the reading of drawing and drawing being depending hold for every condition, transmission binds, and it holds.
laws.zh: 并非空洞成立：在亲代也依存自身的有限孵化中（满足平衡、耗散、体现与活动需要支持的有限世界），取用的读法与取用即依存对每个条件成立，传递起约束，且成立。

laws.en: With the parent's dependence on the food dropped from the finite hatch, a finite world meeting all but transmission satisfies the reading of drawing for every condition, while not everything drawing on the food depends on it and the dependence on the food is not inherited.
laws.zh: 从有限孵化中去掉亲代对食物的依存：这个有限世界满足除传递外的一切，取用的读法对每个条件成立，而并非凡取用食物者都依存它，对食物的依存没有被承继。

laws.en: In novel, a finite world meeting all but transmission, drawing on the parent is depending on it, while the reading of drawing fails for the parent and the dependence on the parent is not inherited; so, among finite worlds meeting the seven other premises, neither the reading of drawing nor the link alone gives inheritance in every one.
laws.zh: 在 novel（满足除传递外一切的有限世界）中，取用亲代即依存它，而取用的读法对亲代不成立，对亲代的依存没有被承继；所以在满足其余七个前提的有限世界中，取用的读法与链接各自单独都不在每个世界给出承继。

hypotheses.zh: 独立与界限对每个世界陈述；推出需要有限、平衡、耗散、体现、活动需要支持、取用的读法与链接，各自公开。
hypotheses.en: Independence and the boundary are stated for every world; the derivation needs finiteness, balance, dissipation, embodiment, activity needing support, the reading of drawing and the link, each supplied openly.

Discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the premises are the World's eight: activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only from what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment, a census and bounded transmission.
hypotheses.zh: 离散的步与自然数的量；前提是世界的八个：活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只从其所取用者取、耗散、体现、普查与有界的传递。

does_not_show.en: That the link is needed is not shown: the finite hatch meets all eight premises, while by its definition, which no theorem restates, its parent draws on itself and depends only on the food.
does_not_show.zh: 没有表明链接是必要的：有限孵化满足全部八个前提，而按其定义（没有定理另行陈述），亲代取用自身、只依存食物。

does_not_show.en: The derivation covers finite worlds meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support, not every world.
does_not_show.zh: 推出只覆盖满足平衡、耗散、体现与活动需要支持的有限世界，不是每个世界。

does_not_show.en: The need half is given within a bound on levels, a coarse bound; where levels are unbounded it is not given.
does_not_show.zh: 需要的一半在水平之界内给出，这是粗界；水平无界处没有给出。

does_not_show.en: Drawing being depending enters as a hypothesis of the derivation; it is not adopted as a law of how dependence forms.
does_not_show.zh: 取用即依存作为推出的假设出现；它没有被采用为依存如何形成的规律。

detail.zh: drawn_without_link 与 link_without_drawn：读法与链接各自都不给出承继。
detail.en: drawn_without_link and link_without_drawn: neither the reading nor the link gives inheritance alone.

next_delta.zh: 在水平无界处推出传递，那里需要的一半没有水平之界可依。

correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”。读法（AI 的读法）：其余七个前提只限制依存，从不要求某个依存；传递要求给予者的依存，所以它不能从它们推出，任何推出都要一条要求依存存在的规律。取用即依存是这样一条规律的候选；它作为推出的前提进入，不采用为形成的规律。
correspondence.en: Following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026. Reading (an AI reading): the seven other premises only limit dependence and never require one; transmission requires the giver's, so it cannot follow from them, and any derivation needs a law requiring some dependence to exist. Drawing being depending is a candidate for such a law; it enters the derivation as a hypothesis and is not adopted as a law of forming.

input.zh: 有限世界中传递恰是承继。
input.en: In finite worlds transmission is exactly inheritance.

conditions.zh: 有限、平衡、耗散、体现、活动需要支持。
conditions.en: Finiteness, balance, dissipation, embodiment, activity needing support.

detail.zh: 回答其 next_delta：传递能否由给予与依存的形成推出。
detail.en: Answers its next_delta: whether transmission can be derived from how giving and dependence form.

detail.zh: 必要且充分的形成规律：一依存在一降中新结，排除承继；给予者的依存稳定时，排除新结给出承继；取用即依存时，取用的读法恰是承继加上给予者取用其所传。
detail.en: A law of forming necessary as well as sufficient: a dependence forming anew at a descent excludes inheritance, and its exclusion gives inheritance where the giver's dependence is stable; where drawing is depending, the reading of drawing is inheritance with the givers drawing what they pass on.

history.en: 28 October 2026: migrated to schema 2 (DF3 batch B, study section 441): the statement narrowed to the conditions of the derivation (finite worlds with balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support), as World.transmitting_of_drawn takes them and the home section says; the claim split into fourteen laws, each read against its declarations in Transmission.lean, Premises.lean and InAmounts.lean; Flow.needsWithin_of_embodied, named by the claim, added to the references of Transmission.lean, and World.MeetsAllBut, World.Premise.Binds, World.finiteHatch and World.novel to those of Premises.lean; the limitations to four does-not-show items and the shared boundaries no-evaluation, no-ethical-premise, discrete-steps and names-provisional; the second hypothesis, that the link is not necessary, moved to a does-not-show item (converse), the finite hatch's parent drawing on itself without depending on itself being its definition, which no theorem states apart from the hatch meeting all eight premises; a hypothesis added naming the representation and the eight premises; the next step's first part, a law of forming necessary as well as sufficient, taken up by forming-anew-necessary-and-sufficient, now related, and its second part kept; the correspondence's work-board item cut; no premise, status or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in [transmission-independent-where-it-binds.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/df3-mapping/transmission-independent-where-it-binds.md); the exact earlier record is the first text_versions entry. The migration's skeptical review was taken in the statement, laws, does-not-show items, related entries, each read against the Lean it cites. A cold read of the applied record was taken in the statement, the correspondence.
history.zh: 2026年10月28日：迁移到 schema 2（DF3 第二批，研究第 441 节）：陈述按 World.transmitting_of_drawn 所取并与归属节一致，收窄到推出的条件（平衡、耗散、体现且活动需要支持的有限世界）；主张拆为十四条规律，各条对照 Transmission.lean、Premises.lean 与 InAmounts.lean 中的声明核读；主张所提的 Flow.needsWithin_of_embodied 加入 Transmission.lean 的引用，World.MeetsAllBut、World.Premise.Binds、World.finiteHatch 与 World.novel 加入 Premises.lean 的引用；限制改为四条“未表明”与通用边界 no-evaluation、no-ethical-premise、discrete-steps、names-provisional；第二条前提（链接并非必要）移为一条“未表明”（逆向），有限孵化中亲代取用自身而不依存自身出于其定义，除孵化满足全部八个前提外没有定理陈述它；新增一条前提，写出表示与八个前提；下一步的前一半（必要且充分的形成规律）已由 forming-anew-necessary-and-sufficient 接续，现列为相关，后一半保留；对应说明中的工作板条目删去；前提、状态与来源哈希均未改变。每句旧文本的去向见 [transmission-independent-where-it-binds.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/df3-mapping/transmission-independent-where-it-binds.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 首项。迁移的审查意见已采纳，涉及陈述、规律、“未表明”各项、相关条目，各条对照所引 Lean 核读。对已应用记录的通读意见已采纳，涉及陈述、对应。
